review: bounded independent concept_1 generation_2 admission and freeze review
verdict: no concrete blocking issue found; final G2 artifact freeze verified

methods: read-only JSON/schema, objective-identity and provenance checks
SHA-256 verification of public, runtime, retained-state and final-freeze bindings
inspection of completed cold-admission reports and their source/request-fingerprinted checkpoints

public_contract.production_imports: standard library, NumPy, SciPy, and the four released production modules only
public_contract.generation_change: explicit new G2 parity-only, zero-field subset after G1 archive; not a retroactive G1 target change
public_contract.hamiltonian_contract: finite projected oscillator powers formed in d+4 before truncation; quartic coefficient lambda4/24; open-chain springs; output basis fixed by request

proposal_review.objective_identity: includes local_dim, bond_cap and sector; excludes only case_id, seed and execution budgets; normalizes numeric coefficient representations
proposal_review.sampling_caveat: a targeted ratchet, not uniform domain coverage: seven N64 and one N32, all d14, caps12/14, four even and four odd

admission_review.baseline_score_interpretation: zero improvement against its own frozen stage outputs, not a standalone measure of task hardness
source_safeguards: strict duplicate-key/nonfinite JSON rejection, scalar types, request lengths, bounds, parity and zero-field checks
four families with two objectives each and no public-example objective overlap
reference containment/no-symlink checks and trusted safe-NPZ load/measurement with 1e-9 energy agreement
fixed-target, fixed-budget, champion-source and current infra5 certificate verification
cold-stage cache keys bind complete requests, all production/public/runtime sources and reported library environment
failed/interrupted resource stages are preserved and not automatically retried or admitted as hardness evidence
physical validity and both positive gaps strictly above 1e-7*N required before publication
source/proposal/reference hashes rechecked after cold stages; 24 retained states and exact requests pinned
old cases/calibration backed up; atomic individual-file publication with exception rollback; final independent validation required before launch freeze
admission_review.publication_boundary: cases/calibration are not a single atomic pair; a crash between writes is incomplete publication, not a launch-ready freeze. The reviewed final pair and validation hashes match.

infrastructure.guard_assessment: unchanged blocking wait4/protected wall and CPU accounting; kernel grace does not relax final CPU or wall eligibility; mandatory containment has no unrestricted fallback
infrastructure.network_and_historical_cache_caveats: existing final_isolation_audit_v2 findings retained, not re-investigated or superseded

freeze_builder_guards_reviewed: 24-state valid report bound to calibration hash
G1 solved status identical to archived G1 status

scientific_interpretation.references: retained attainable same-cap variational states, not exact ground-state energies and not proof of a full budget-feasible algorithm
scientific_interpretation.eligible_baseline_failure_evidence: all formal long stages exit normally within 2.672048 to 20.255516 CPU seconds yet remain above references; the admission evidence is energetic, not a resource failure

n32_completion.interpretation: same-domain, same-cap attainable improvement with clean under-budget search runs; consistent with an optimizer local minimum, not a proof of mechanism

scientific_interpretation.knowledge_flag: full_passing_algorithm_known_at_admission=false is a historical admission-time assertion. A later unchanged-v3 full-target grade may legitimately establish a passing algorithm without changing this flag or the frozen target.

limitations: No new physical contractions, simulations, sandbox probes, grades or runtime tests were executed; recorded measurements are bound by hashes rather than independently reproduced in this review.
Reference attainability and baseline improvement do not establish computational hardness, global optimality, or infeasibility of a complete solver.
The short calibration CPU maximum is close to 6 seconds; later resource anomalies must be assessed separately rather than counted as scientific difficulty.
No v5/v6 source, output, log, session or completion manifest was read; this is not a 15-run isolation assurance.
The final freeze is verified as a coherent immutable snapshot; its declared prelaunch state is not a substitute for later actual-run isolation/provenance checks.
